# Mana

Mana is a local macOS menu-bar app for Codex, OpenCode Go, and Antigravity usage. Antigravity includes Gemini and Claude/GPT coding-plan quotas, not separate subscriptions.
Website: https://mana.salsaparapizza.com/
Source and documentation: https://github.com/cris7ian/mana
Latest signed and notarized installer: https://github.com/cris7ian/mana/releases/latest
Install with Homebrew: `brew install --cask cris7ian/tap/mana` (tap: https://github.com/cris7ian/homebrew-tap). The cask links the `mana` command into Homebrew's `bin` directory, so it is available in the terminal after installation.
Requires macOS 13 or later. MIT licensed.
The macOS app, iPhone prototype, and widgets support English, German, Spanish, and French, with English fallback.

See remaining usage from the menu bar. Codex and OpenCode Go show reset times; Antigravity does not. A separate Claude subscription is only a browser link in Settings. See the README for setup and CLI details.

macOS privacy: Usage snapshots are not persisted. Mana stores Codex and OpenCode Go credentials in private local files. Mana does not read or store Antigravity credentials.

iPhone status: The repository contains a standalone iOS 18+ prototype for Codex and OpenCode Go, with quota cards and Home Screen/Lock Screen widgets. Antigravity and the CLI remain macOS-only. Live provider access, public provider permission, and signed-device behavior remain unverified. The macOS downloads are not iPhone installers; no verified public iPhone release is claimed.
iPhone guide: https://github.com/cris7ian/mana/blob/main/ios/README.md
App Store asset proposal and open release gates: https://github.com/cris7ian/mana/tree/main/app-store-release-prep
iPhone privacy: Credentials use non-synchronizing, device-only Keychain storage. A protected, backup-excluded App Group cache holds only the latest normalized quota values and freshness metadata. No history or raw responses are retained. Disconnecting clears the provider's credentials and cached usage. Widget/background refresh is best-effort and system-controlled. Demo screenshots contain labeled synthetic values, not live usage evidence.

Mana is not affiliated with OpenAI, OpenCode Go, Google, or Antigravity. For current behavior and installation instructions, consult the source repository and latest release rather than inferring account details from this page.
